name: application-team-members-list
title: Team Members List
description: Row-based team management list with avatar, name/email, a per-row role select, a pending-invite state, and a remove action.
useWhen: Building a settings page where an admin manages who belongs to a workspace/organization and what role they hold.
You need to represent both active members (with an assignable role) and pending invitees in one consistent list.
Each row needs its own inline action (role change, remove/cancel) rather than a bulk table toolbar.
avoidWhen: The list is large enough to need sorting, filtering, or pagination — pair this pattern with `tables` instead once row count grows past a page's worth.
You're displaying arbitrary structured data with no membership/role semantics — use the generic `details-list` instead.
Roles aren't user-editable inline — a read-only `avatar-group` or plain list is simpler when there's nothing to manage.
responsiveBehavior: Rows are a single flex line with a truncating name/email column; on narrow viewports, wrap this list in a horizontally scrollable container or drop the role select to a secondary line to avoid clipping the email in the min-w-0 column.
accessibility: Each role <select> has an associated (visually hidden) label naming the specific member it controls, since multiple selects share the same visual context.
Remove/cancel-invite buttons are icon-only with an explicit aria-label that includes the member's name.
Pending invites are communicated via a text badge ("Invite pending"), not color alone, so the state is conveyed to screen readers and colorblind users alike.
Avatar images are decorative (empty alt) since the name is present as adjacent text; members without a photo fall back to text initials rather than a broken image.

variants.title: Team Members List
variants.description: Two active members with role selects and one pending invitee, plus an Invite member action.
accessibility: Role changes and removals are driven by real state in the React variant, not just visual mockups.

variants.title: Team Members List (Dark)
variants.description: Team members list adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Pending-invite badge and hover states are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
